A CASE STUDY ON FUMIGANTS
Problems with traditional fumigation
•   Some chemicals released during fumigation may damage the Earth’s layer.
•   After methyl bromide treatment, paintings may lose some of their original .
•   To prevent dangerous gas from escaping, food can be placed inside a sealed .
•   In countries with humid conditions, the treatment is often more because additional equipment is required.
An alternative treatment
•   Researchers created an environment containing almost no oxygen.
•   The total period used in the experiment lasted fourteen days.
•   Air was removed from the sealed space and replaced with .
•   The new method was tested on an old wooden that had been attacked by insects.
•   The treatment killed the insects without causing visible damage to the object.
A possible biological solution
•   Scientists have examined protective substances found in the skin of certain .
•   These natural chemicals behave in a similar way to , as they destroy harmful organisms.
•   One current limitation is that the substances become less effective when exposed to .

analyses.content: 录音中提到释放的化学物质会影响（affect对应题目中的damage）ozone layer（臭氧层），所以答案是 ozone。
你可能会听到前面第12句的 atmosphere（大气），但这里题目明确问的是具体破坏了什么“layer（层）”，所以应该填 ozone。
In particular, some of the chemicals released during the process can affect the ozone layer. This is important because the ozone layer protects the Earth from harmful ultraviolet radiation.
录音指出使用溴甲烷会降低画作 color（颜色）的强度（reduce the strength对应题目中的lose some of their original），因此填 colour 或 color。
你可能会想填 strength（强度）或 pigments（颜料），但这里修饰的是画作“失去了原有的某样东西”，根据录音语境，失去的是颜色的强度，核心名词是 color。
For example, if methyl bromide was used on a painting, it could reduce the strength of its color. In some cases, pigments became noticeably less bright after treatment.
录音明确说到为了防止气体泄漏（prevented the gas from escaping），食物会被放在一个 sealed bag（密封袋）里，直接对应题目内容。
你可能会听到 contained 或是 environment 并被干扰，但题目中空前有非常明确的修饰词 sealed（密封的），这直接对应录音里听到的 sealed bag。

Because the gas was dangerous to breathe, both the object and the chemical had to be completely contained. In the food industry, for example, food could be kept inside a sealed bag while the fumigant was introduced. This prevented the gas from escaping.
录音里提到在潮湿的国家需要额外设备（extra equipment对应题目中的additional equipment），这会让过程变得更缓慢且更 expensive（昂贵）。
你可能会听到 slower 就直接当答案填了，但题目空前有 more 修饰，英语中比较级不会说 more slower，只能和 expensive 搭配。
In humid countries, extra equipment may be required to control the treatment conditions. That can make the process slower and more expensive.
题目寻找总计14天的什么“时期（period）”，录音中的原话是 total exposure time（总暴露时间），time 对应了 period，因此填 exposure。
你可能会想填 treatment，但忽略了整体语义，录音里明确和“14天”直接连用且作定语修饰时间的是 exposure。
The total exposure time was 14 days. That's longer than some chemical treatments, but it was much safer, both for the objects and for the people carrying out the treatment.
录音原句直白地说明密封空间里的空气被移除，并且被替换成了（replaced with）nitrogen（氮气）。
你可能会听到紧接着出现的 oxygen（氧气）就填上去了，但那是用来解释昆虫需要氧气所以死掉的原因，并不是用来替换空气的气体。
The object was placed in a sealed environment where air was removed and replaced with nitrogen. Since insects need oxygen, they eventually died.
题目问这种方法在什么古老的木制物品上做测试，录音直接给出了 tested on an old wooden sculpture（雕塑）。
你可能会因为没跟上 sculpture 或者忽略了具体名词而想填 object 或 wood，但填空题一定要做好预判，紧跟形容词后面的核心名词才是关键。
The method was tested on an old wooden sculpture that had been badly infested. At the end of the 14 days, the insects had been destroyed and the wood was unharmed.
录音提到科学家们在某些 frogs（青蛙）的皮肤（skins对应题目中的skin）中发现了保护性化学物质，直接对应填空。
你可能会被后面一句总结性的 animals（动物）干扰，但题目中有 certain（某些）作为限定修饰词，必须填入录音里具体的物种 frogs。
Some are studying chemicals found in the skins of certain frogs. These substances help protect the animals from infection.
题目说这些自然化学物质的作用方式类似于什么，录音中 act like（表现得像，对应题目behave in a similar way to）后面紧跟着的就是 natural pesticides（天然杀虫剂）。
你可能听到 bacteria 或者 microorganisms 就急着填，但这俩是被化学物质“消灭”的有害生物，而不是它们“起效方式的同类物”。
Researchers have found that they can destroy harmful microorganisms, so they act like natural pesticides, killing bacteria before they cause an infection.
录音提到在有 moisture（水分）存在的情况下（in the presence of对应题目exposed to），这些物质变得不那么有效（not very effective对应become less effective）。
你可能会听到下一句解释原理的 water，虽然意思大体相近，但紧跟在“存在导致无效”这一直接条件短语后的原词是 moisture。
However, they're not very effective in the presence of moisture. Water may dilute them or break them down, so more research is needed.
